title: Roblox Hi
blurb: Two letters, maximum enthusiasm, pitched somewhere near the ceiling. The squeaky Roblox hi echoes across every lobby ever generated, usually from a player whose avatar is wearing three hats and nothing else. Friendship at its most efficient — no small talk, no preamble, immediate wholesome energy aimed at a stranger you will betray in about four minutes. Play it on entering any space, digital or physical, to set the tone before anyone can object. The griefing arrives later. The hi is always completely sincere.
origin: The iconic high-pitched greeting from Roblox voice/chat culture.
